tagline: Private Admin-Only 24/7 Fiduciary Ambient Strategist • Iceberg `[Defend That]` Receipts & Stage-Never-Send Inbox

quickstart.detail: Tap `⚙️ Settings` in the top system strip to set your `sapphire_cloud_url` (Cloud Run URL for 24/7 mobile access or `http://127.0.0.1:8085` when tunneling locally).
Use the top-right mode selector (`🟢 Active`, `🌙 Silent`, or `⛔ Off`) to control whether Sapphire proactively surfaces briefings or queues items quietly in your Staged Inbox.

quickstart.step: Chat & Audit Reasoning via `🛡️ Defend That`
quickstart.detail: Send concise strategic questions in the mobile stream. Every substantive recommendation carries an Iceberg `🛡️ Defend That` button that reveals full underlying fiduciary receipts on demand.
Inspect pending drafts and action items prepared by Sapphire—nothing is ever transmitted externally without your explicit review and approval.

deep_dive_features.title: Iceberg Output Pattern (`🛡️ Defend That`)
deep_dive_features.body: Keeps mobile replies concise and executive-ready on the surface while preserving deterministic citations, calendar/email context, and trade-off math one tap underneath.

deep_dive_features.title: Strict `Stage, Never Send` Safety Boundary
deep_dive_features.body: Enforces human-in-the-loop governance: Sapphire prepares drafts in your Staged Inbox and never auto-sends external emails or mutates production records unapproved.

pro_tips: Switch to `🌙 Silent` during deep-focus meetings so Sapphire continues triaging into your Staged Inbox without interruptions.
